item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! Happy weekend! A whole day to play. Let's find out what the weather is like on this Sunday, September 27. Sunday. A slow and cosy sort of day. Shanghai is going to be thundery today. The high will be 30 degrees, and the low will be 24 degrees. Properly hot today, the kind that makes you seek out shade. The chance of rain is 81 percent. Did you know today is day 270 of the year? There are 95 days to go until the new one. Don't forget your umbrella today! And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be showery, with a high of 27 degrees. Think about this one: what is the funniest sound you can make? That's all from the weather desk. Enjoy your day!
